pages.text: Wants a room: walls, a floor and a ceiling, with no way out to the sky. At least 27 blocks of space.$(p)Grants:$(li)Cleansing Font, growing with the tier, up to +6.$(p)Tiers begin at a score of 5.

Will not count without:$(li)1 of Water Cauldron$(p)Rewards, most first:$(li)Water Cauldron$(li)Pointed Dripstone$(li)Azalea or Flowering Azalea$(li)Dripstone Block$(li)Moss Block or Moss Carpet$(p)Counts against it:$(li)Lava$(li)Magma Block$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#smithing)any smithing$(/l)
pages.title: What counts

pages.text: None of this is required, but building it well earns more than the blocks alone:$(li)Dripstone sits over basin, and greenery surrounds basin.
pages.title: How you arrange it

pages.text: What those parts are:$(li)Dripstone: Pointed Dripstone$(li)Basin: Water Cauldron$(li)Greenery: Azalea or Flowering Azalea or Moss Block or Moss Carpet
